title: Fixed Three Deep Shanks and Winged Points Subsoiler
description: One newly authored whole parked three-shank subsoiler-style implement. A high long rectangular toolbar carries three separate deep narrow forward-curving solid shanks in complete mounting saddles, with three broad finite blunt winged points at their feet. A raised triangular attachment-style frame has three actual open eyes and two rear braces. Two outside gauge-wheel assemblies include full angled carrier arms, horizontal axles, grounded tyres, proud hubs and smooth top adjustment-stem exteriors with cross grips. The three winged points and two wheel facets define this one fixed parked display. No tractor, soil, trench, hydraulic system, detachable point, separate stand or scene platform. Every visible coordinate newly authored; no mouldboard plough, drag-harrow, disc-harrow, planter or mower geometry imported. Not an old low timber tooth frame with fewer teeth or a curling mouldboard replated. One model zero scenes. Blunt static art only: no subsoiling, cutting, draft, breakaway action, depth adjustment, wheel rolling, articulation, attachment fit, soil improvement, load, stability, engineering, manufacture or safety capability made or verified. Rigging, animation and interaction not made.
